items.title: ConocoPhillips Sold 43,000 South Texas Acres for $1.2 Billion. At 63, a Landowner Can Keep Getting Oil Royalties Without Social Security Calling Them Work.
items.summary: A 63-year-old mineral owner collects royalty checks while another company drills his wells, but filing for Social Security early turns that seemingly passive income into a high-stakes question about which dollars actually count against him.

items.title: XOM Keeps Climbing. Should You Climb On?
items.summary: A large energy stock is running hot on real operational strength, forcing investors to decide if the ticket price for this momentum is already too high.

items.title: Why ConocoPhillips (COP) Dipped More Than Broader Market Today
items.summary: In the closing of the recent trading day, ConocoPhillips (COP) stood at $132.54, denoting a -6.15% move from the preceding trading day.

items.title: Only 11 of 237 Active Dividend Funds Beat SCHD’s Index
items.summary: A 15-year scorecard just revealed how badly active dividend fund managers fared against a passive benchmark, and the results raise a pointed question about whether the most popular dividend ETF belongs in your portfolio right now.

items.title: Chevron Doesn’t Need Oil to Hit New Highs. Here’s What Could Drive the Stock Instead
items.summary: Chevron just posted its strongest downstream quarter in years while quietly signing a power deal with Microsoft that management calls a repeatable model independent of oil prices. The question is whether Wall Street has already priced in the transformation or whether the bigger move is still ahead.

items.title: Oil Producers Slide as Crude Retreats: EOG Resources Drops 6%, ConocoPhillips and Occidental Petroleum Fall 5%
items.summary: Crude prices retreated Wednesday and the pain landed squarely on exploration and production names, skipping refiners and midstream entirely. Here is why that mechanical link turned a commodity move into a sector-wide shakeout for some of the biggest names in the energy patch.

items.title: Should You Buy ExxonMobil Stock For What Guyana Pays Next?
items.summary: ExxonMobil (XOM) stock has gained about 52% over the past year and now trades right at the top of its 52-week range. Anyone buying here is paying for something still ahead. The clearest candidate sits offshore Guyana, where the company has just finished earning back what it put in.

items.title: Oil Executives Say the Great Fuel Crisis Is Here
items.summary: Trump officials say the oil-market disruption is temporary, but Chevron’s Mike Wirth and others warn global supplies are running low, with no respite in sight.
